description.short: Your dev URLs, accounts and API tokens, encrypted on this PC.
description.full: Developer Keys keeps the values developers forget (environment URLs, accounts, API tokens, connection strings, keys) encrypted on your own PC, with search, copy-to-clipboard and automatic encrypted backups. It is served by the Developer Keys host running on this PC at https://localhost:53917, and your vault never leaves it. Optional Smart add, shown only when Claude Code is signed in on this PC, sends text you paste to Claude through that sign-in.
